Java bytecode and .NET IL engines are deferred behind the same interface.

06-cve-reachability.planned_scope: Deterministic Python correlator (ADR-0023) over the exact accepted SCA matches and the engine tables of 06-reachability-codeql and 06-reachability-ir: reachable needs a hash-bound witness from a proof-capable engine, unreachable only from the complete IR/CPG engine with the dependency source present, disagreement is conflict (listed, never resolved silently), language-server and tree-sitter results are hints only. Publishes cve-reachability.json in its existing contract, the per-match dependency-reachability.json and the summary for the report and lanes 07-12. Version matches alone never establish reachability and outputs remain evidence leads.

15-deployment-hardening.planned_scope: Config-driven static deployment assessment over explicit accepted configuration and STIG/SRG inputs; runtime state and compliance remain unclaimed gaps.

02-code-property-graph.planned_scope: Pinned offline Joern produces bounded source-located AST/CPG records for structural calls, symbols, types, candidate flows and memory operations; every hit remains locator-only until source dereference.

02-treesitter-ast.planned_scope: Pinned offline tree-sitter parse of the checkout: per-file functions with spans, call sites and imports as a hash-bound records file; a second AST source beside the CPG, locator-only.

02-code-index.planned_scope: Deterministic SQLite code index (methods, resolved calls and escapes, types, identifiers, literals, tree-sitter spans and outlines, export joins, IR fact functions, debug symbols, FTS) built from accepted artifacts for the model jobs' structural query tools (ADR-0032).

02-native-sast.planned_scope: Compile-database analyzers with generated headers; independent of RE/IR output.

02-ir-capture.planned_scope: Instrumented build capture or explicitly labelled compiler replay with matching generated inputs and compiler version.

02-ir-link.planned_scope: Link per compatible product/module and build variant; preserve failed and excluded translation units.

02-ir-facts.planned_scope: Extract compiled facts, call edges, debug locations and memory operations; no verified finding claims.

02-debug-symbol-index.planned_scope: Verify binary/symbol identity, index DWARF/PDB; absence is explicit and does not disable binary triage.

02-binary-triage.planned_scope: Static file/header/section/import/string/security-property inspection and bounded Binwalk signatures.

02-binary-cfg.planned_scope: Bounded static Ghidra/angr CFG and call-graph extraction. Record uncertainty and limits; no target execution.

02-test-execution.planned_scope: Explicit isolated test plan; capture test results and optional instrumentation, with time/resource limits.

02-test-result-ingest.planned_scope: Consume unit/integration/regression results by suite; distinguish missing, skipped, failed and passed.

02-test-coverage-ingest.planned_scope: Consume coverage only when instrumentation is identified; missing coverage is an explicit gap.

02-operations-doc-ingest.planned_scope: Consume runbooks, deployment/build guides and operational constraints with source citations.

02-secrets-inventory.planned_scope: Redacted secret and key-material location inventory (ADR-0010). Static and offline; raw values never leave the attempt; evidence leads only.

02-iac-config-scan.planned_scope: Declared IaC, Kubernetes and Dockerfile configuration evidence plus base-image references (ADR-0010). Offline, policy bundles baked in; declared exposure only; skipped only with a zero-input probe receipt.

02-container-image-inventory.planned_scope: Static inventory of OCI/docker image archives supplied as run inputs (ADR-0010 G8). No registry pull, build or container start; skipped only with a zero-input probe receipt.

02-sbom-inventory.planned_scope: Offline CycloneDX inventory through the pinned Syft B13 adapter from an explicit run-owned source snapshot, enriched from exact accepted build-index lineage for conservatively recognized build-referenced vendored members. Enrichment never fabricates purl or CPE identifiers: a vendored member gets them only from hash-bound evidence (cJSON's version macros, P19); a member that cannot be versioned is an explicit gap. P36/P37: optionally consumes the accepted 02-native-build's per-unit build-dependencies.json (skip binds nothing): OS packages the build consumed become pkg:deb components scoped load-time (DT_NEEDED) or build-time (headers/static only), vendored header trees become macro-versioned candidates, and unattributed out-of-checkout files are gaps. P43: optionally consumes the accepted 02-iac-config-scan base-image-inventory.json (skip binds nothing; a failed scan does not hold the SBOM): installed OS packages of resolved base images become pkg:deb/pkg:apk components scoped container-base with the image reference and EOL status; unresolved images are gaps.

02-sca-vulnerability-match.planned_scope: Offline Grype and OSV version matching against the accepted SBOM and explicitly configured, hash-verified, age-bounded supplied snapshots. Grype always executes. OSV executes only for purl-bearing components; otherwise its applicability gate publishes an evidence-supported per-tool SKIPPED_NA receipt while retaining the validated OSV snapshot identity and the node publishes OK_WITH_GAPS. Snapshot synchronization is outside the analysis DAG; matches are leads, never reachability.

02-license-scan.planned_scope: Offline ScanCode license evidence through B13, with component references resolved into the exact accepted SBOM and source citations bound to the run snapshot.

02-dependency-lifecycle.planned_scope: Deterministic transform over the accepted SBOM and license inventory using an explicit hash-bound, age-bounded run-owned reference table; missing coverage remains unknown.

02-binary-hardening.planned_scope: Static hardening properties of the immutable binary projection published by the accepted 02-native-build attempt. No target execution, debugger or symbol server; every scanned byte is bound to the native-build pointer, envelope, result and artifact hash.

02-binary-component-cve-match.planned_scope: Known-vulnerable components embedded in the immutable binary projection of the accepted 02-native-build attempt: pinned cve-bin-tool 3.4, offline, against the database cve_bin_tool_db.py derives from the run's NVD snapshot (no second download). Matches are vendor/product/version-range leads, never findings or reachability; NVD is the only source loaded.

02-mobile-sast.planned_scope: Mobile static leads gated by an in-worker platform-marker probe (ADR-0010 G6); bare Java, Kotlin or Objective-C files are not a marker. Offline; skipped only with a zero-marker probe receipt.

persona-tool-pool-dispatch.planned_scope: Expand a registered pool specification through C01, launch and wait through C02, and publish only the reverified terminal population identity.

deterministic-pool-merge.planned_scope: Typed deterministic merge over the exact terminal population and adapter results reverified by C02; raw caller-authored merges are refused.

evidence-qualified-quorum.planned_scope: Independent producer quorum over the current accepted deterministic merge reference only.

dynamic-rescope.planned_scope: Bounded affected-only dependency rescope with monotonic accepted predecessor lineage.

completeness-audit.planned_scope: Evidence-bound completeness audit kept distinct from subsequent synthetic-hypothesis feedback.
